status: static schema closure prepared; remote compatibility and complete CAD goal remain pending
confidence_scope: Native 2026 wire order, types, branch/count boundaries and owner dispatch only. Raw decoded fields are not the final native runtime object, a generative value classification or candidate acceptance.

identity_evidence.method: Independent PE32+ metadata reads: RT_VERSION VS_FIXEDFILEINFO, export table, primary vtable slot5, x64 RTTI complete-object locator/type descriptor, and exception-directory unwind chain grouping. No target execution.
identity_evidence.rea_session: target-free inspection; no active analysis target or shared project mutation

version_policy.current_alias: Existing Dsl.ver treats missing/zero archive version as CURRENT=19000. This is a codec convention, not a claim that native runtime state always returns 19000.
version_policy.guard: AnnotationWire.current_19000 is the first zero-byte operation in each of the 52 explicit schemas on load and store. Other effective versions raise ArchiveError before owner fields.

native_helpers.rule: Read the archive file version at +0x7c0, falling back when zero; absent archive helper throws.

unchanged_dependencies.record_policy: Only actually reached schemas affect strict proof. No unrelated registry name is promoted; optional GTol dependencies outside this set remain provisional.

key_compatibility.policy: Exact legacy keys remain, including f8/f08 and fc/f0c variants, list row keys, and f3e8#0. Native offsets are not fixed file positions.

baseline_remote_reports.scope: These complete retained reports predate this change and demonstrate the provisional owners were actually reached. They do not validate the new modules.
